intro.speaker: Kelsier
lines: Clubs keeps his shop dark at night. Good. Nobody watches a dark shop.
Here. A mistcloak. Every Mistborn wears one. It hides your outline from the soldiers.
And drink this. Eight metals, flakes in alcohol. You will feel them in your stomach, like little reserves.

tin.speaker: Kelsier
lines: Tin first. Burn it and your senses sharpen: the mists thin, the night grows bright, and you hear what the city whispers.
Find the tin inside you and burn it.

tin_after.speaker: Kelsier
lines: Listen. A patrol, two streets over.
But mind the light. Look at that lamplighter. With tin burning, a lantern in your face is a hammer to the eyes.

pewter.speaker: Kelsier
lines: You will never make that gap on your own legs. Burn pewter: strength, speed, balance.
Burn it now, then run and jump.

pewter_after.speaker: Kelsier
lines: Pewter keeps you on your feet, until it runs out. Flare it too long and you will collapse where you stand.

coin.speaker: Kelsier
lines: Now the fun part. Steel. Burn it and you will see blue lines to every bit of metal around you.
Take these clips. Drop one, stand over it, and Push. Push from your centre, straight down, or it skids away.

pull.speaker: Kelsier
lines: Iron is steel's sister. Pull, and the metal comes to you, or you go to the metal, whichever is lighter.
That lamp bracket across the street is heavier than you. Pull on it.
And when you are done, hold Pull with nothing in your sights and your clips will come home.

run.speaker: Kelsier
lines: Good. Now keep up. The city wall, before the mists lift.

wall.speaker: Kelsier
lines: Welcome to the night, Vin. It belongs to us now.
Copper, bronze, zinc and brass you will learn in time. Tonight you flew.
